item.title: Narita Unagi Guide: Best Eel Restaurants & Access
item.description: The temple town of Narita is one of the best places near Tokyo to feast on unagi (freshwater eel) — a tradition stretching back centuries to feed pilgrims visiting Narita-san. Along the atmospheric Omotesando approach to the temple, dozens of long-established eel restaurants fillet, skewer and grill eel fresh to order, often in full view of the street, then glaze it in sweet-savoury tare sauce over rice as unadon or unaju.
